Thanks for the ping + the CSV, Diego. I pulled the token tallies and did a targeted export of request-level metadata for Magellan across 2026-06-01 — 2026-06-11. High-level findings:

- Invoice shows 1,203,412 embedding tokens billed.
- Magellan's internal run reports ~302,117 unique items sent for embedding.
- Our request logs include ~910k tokens that match an identical input payload hash but with different transient request IDs (pattern: mag-req-<session>-<seq>). Many of these cluster into short time windows (sub-minute) coming from the same client IPs.

Root-cause hypothesis: their ingest client library (v0.14.x) pads streaming chunks and, under transient network timeouts, resubmits chunk uploads without stable idempotency keys. Because our billing counts per successful token processed, duplicate chunks were charged. Our dedup heuristics only collapse identical request ids; since the retry created a new id but identical payload, duplicates slipped through.

Proposed remediation (provisional):
- Hold collection for INV-6942 until we’ve validated full logs (customer requested hold already).
- Produce a usage export (we've attached a short excerpt) and ask Magellan for their SDK version + any client logs for the same windows.
- Offer a provisional credit for the deduplicated tokens while the joint investigation proceeds. Numbers below:
  - Over-billed tokens (billed - expected) = 1,203,412 - 302,117 = 901,295 tokens
  - Tokens we can attribute to probable duplicates from quick-scan = 620,450 tokens
  - Rate: $0.0004 per embedding token (hosted tier) => provisional credit = 620,450 * $0.0004 = $248.18

Recommendation: approve provisional credit of $248 (round to $250 to expedite). If Magellan supplies client logs showing the duplicates were client retries/CID issues, convert provisional credit to final. If evidence shows the duplication was caused by Redwood routing or replay, escalate for larger remediation.

I've attached a 2-page excerpt (redwood_token_log_excerpt.txt) and a query we ran. Once I have Ben's sign-off I'll route to billing to issue an adjustment and mark the invoice as disputed/held in our collection system.

Marissa Cole
